main_body: Multi-storey school building: a flat green rooftop with a parapet above a cream facade with four rows of windows and a glass entrance door
top_band: Green rooftop surface with texture, rows ~3-19, inside a light grey-lavender parapet. The parapet's front lip (rows ~19-22) is lighter, then a dark green line sits at the front edge.
evidence: A column through the middle shows a grey parapet rim, a large green roof band about 17 rows tall seen from above with rooftop units on it, a light front lip, a dark green line, a grey cornice band, then the cream facade of about 64 rows with windows. The roof is a clearly readable horizontal surface and not a thin rim. Windows have sills and darker frames, and the door is set into a dark frame under a canopy. No receding side faces.

style.evidence: The green roof has several greens, grass-like dots and dark tufts. The facade has speckled cream plaster, grey-lavender cornices and sills, and windows with multi-tone glass and diagonal reflections. The brick base carries per-brick variation. Outlines are mostly tinted: dark grey-blue beside the grey trim, dark green beside the roof. The door frame is near black, so the outline reads as mixed. Large wall areas are broken up by speckle and no big flat fills remain. Overall it is only slightly lighter in material variety than the reference, but it would sit acceptably next to it.
